summary: DNSSEC needs cryptographic algorithms to sign DNS data, and IANA keeps a registry of them but not their recommended implementation status. This applicability statement lists each DNSKEY algorithm's status for DNSSEC software. It was replaced by RFC 8624.

eli5.summary: This is a chart saying which secret-code methods DNS security software should support. A newer chart replaced it.

questions: which dnssec algorithms should be implemented
